info.name: FloodOS - Hanoi Flood Response API (Tier 1 core + application)
info.description: Executable contract of the FloodOS API. Run against the gateway (:9080) with the 'FloodOS Gateway (Docker)' environment, after filling the *_token variables with PKCE tokens (see docs/api-spec.md section 2). All demo data is SIMULATED. Roles: REPORTER, DISPATCHER, FIELD_TEAM, RESOURCE_MANAGER, PLATFORM_ADMIN.

item.name: 0. Platform (no token)
Health: roles registered by the application, BPMN processes loaded
Protected state without a token is refused
Internal ingest endpoints are sealed at the gateway

exec: pm.test('404 at the edge or 401 from the core', () => pm.expect([404, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: 1. Resident reports a flood (REPORTER)
State is scoped to the resident's own reports

exec: pm.test('the payload says the data is simulated', () => pm.expect(b.data_notice).to.include('MÔ PHỎNG'));

item.name: File a report (zone matched by straight-line distance)

body.raw:
{
  "lat": 20.9665,
  "lng": 105.8712,
  "depth_cm": 55,
  "need_type": "EVACUATION",
  "people_affected": 5,
  "description": "Nước vào nhà, cần đưa người già ra điểm trú"
}

item.name: Invalid depth is a 400, not a silent default
A position far from every monitored zone is refused
A resident cannot verify
A resident cannot dispatch
2. Dispatcher verifies and dispatches (DISPATCHER)
Verify and set priority
The other tenant's dispatcher cannot see this report (404)
Dispatch boat V02 with team T02
File and verify a second report
Verify the second report
Double-booking the vehicle -> 409 RESOURCE_TIME_OVERLAP
Double-booking the team -> 409 HOLDER_TIME_OVERLAP
A vehicle in maintenance cannot be booked
A pump cannot be sent to evacuate (422)
The resource manager does not approve dispatches
3. Field team (FIELD_TEAM)
Another team cannot see the order (404)
The right team starts the order
Progress cannot go backwards (409)
Report a vehicle incident (V02)

exec: pm.test('options are ranked and say the distance is straight-line', () => body.candidate_options.forEach(o => pm.expect(o.distance_kind).to.eql('STRAIGHT_LINE_HAVERSINE')));
pm.test('the broken vehicle is not offered', () => body.candidate_options.forEach(o => pm.expect(o.vehicle_id).to.not.eql('V02')));

item.name: The field team cannot approve a re-plan
4. Re-plan and repair (DISPATCHER, RESOURCE_MANAGER)
Approval needs an explicit option (no auto-dispatch)
Approve the chosen replacement
A field team cannot touch the repair ticket
The resource manager closes the repair ticket
5. Completion and confirmation
The replacement team completes the order

request.description: Set the collection variable replacement_team_token to the token of the team that leads the replacement order (see the new order in GET /api/v1/state).

item.name: Another resident cannot confirm (404)
The resident confirms
6. Audit and analytics
Verify the SHA-256 chain
Lineage of the case
Cold analytics: summary (DISPATCHER)

exec: pm.test('200 or 503 while the lake warms up', () => pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Cold analytics is closed to residents
Public traceability JSON for the case (no token)

exec: pm.test('200 once the case reached the lake, otherwise 404', () => pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: 7. Digital twin and shelters
NGSI-LD entities (vehicles and gauges, with data source)

exec: pm.test('every entity declares its data source', () => pm.response.json().entities.forEach(e => pm.expect(e).to.have.property('dataSource')));

item.name: Update shelter occupancy (DISPATCHER)
Occupancy above capacity is refused
A resident cannot change shelter occupancy
